claims.claim: Infleqtion's September 24 roadmap targets 100 logical qubits in 2028 and 1,000 in 2030, while its own filing cautions that commercial readiness, quantum advantage, customer technical requirements, partnerships and commercialization remain uncertain; Alpha can therefore treat roadmap conversion rather than roadmap existence as the source-addressed execution-risk question.

risks.risk: Forward logical-qubit milestones may not convert into commercially valuable quantum advantage or scalable customer deployments on the stated timetable.

falsifiers: Independent benchmark evidence of commercially valuable quantum advantage at the stated logical-qubit milestones plus repeatable customer deployments would materially reduce this execution-risk concern.

unknowns.unknown: Independent economics and customer utility of the revised roadmap milestones remain unverified in this assist.
